## Executive Summary
* Examines how town size, location, and population affect education outcomes in England
* Stronger education outcomes near major universities, especially in the South East
* Coastal and northern towns tend to lag behind
* Highlights need for targeted investment to address regional disparities.


## Introduction
* Dataset includes town sizes of large, medium, and small
* Includes coastal proximity and demographics
* Focus on outcomes at age 19 and 22:
  * Qualification levels
  * Full-time education or employment
* Key indicators: education score, employment types, apprenticeship participation
